name: Aurora
description: A magical-sky theme for NimbusCMS — deep-indigo night grounds, an aurora accent, and moonlit-parchment content. Ships a fully-styled Storefront (shop) and generic content templates. Plain PHP, one stylesheet, no build step, no external assets. An official theme.

templates.layout: HTML shell; includes header and footer.
templates.header: Wordmark + main menu on the night ground.
templates.footer: Footer menu + colophon under an aurora hairline.
templates.entry-home: The storefront landing page (the `home` singleton). Composes optional authored fields: eyebrow (hero kicker), tagline (H1), subhead (lead), hero {url,alt} (image), promise (one 'Label | detail' per line → the promise strip), aisles (one 'Label | detail | /relative-url' per line → shop-by-aisle tiles; links are relative-only), body (prose about-teaser), closing_title + closing (the closing night band). Every field is optional — the page degrades gracefully.
templates.entry: A single entry — a centered reading column on parchment. String fields render through the theme's small prose parser (## headings, - / 1. lists, **bold**, [text](/relative) links — escape-first, relative links only).
templates.collection: A collection's entries as a card grid.
templates.shop-index: Overrides the Storefront plugin's listing (ADR 0023) — a night hero, filter bar, and product grid.
templates.shop-product: Overrides the Storefront plugin's product page — a two-column parchment layout.

specialization: Add collection-{handle} or entry-{handle} to override the generic template for one collection. `nav` is true (every browsable collection is offered to the header/nav). Aurora also overrides the Storefront plugin's `shop-index`/`shop-product` section templates (ADR 0023 — theme templates win).
assets: Files under assets/ are served at /theme/assets/<path>. app.css is the whole design system — system fonts and CSS-only motifs, no external or binary assets, so it loads under the strict same-origin CSP.
